description: A module-level string constant fixes the host of a URL built from it (`API + p`, `${API}...`, through an assignment). A name rebound by a parameter is not that constant, and a helper whose pass-through return path is Top does not make its other return path's host lock apply to the call.

expected.notes: host fixed by the module constant or a literal head
the structural rule reads the same prefix
`API` is a parameter of build(), not the module constant
helper() returns its argument unchanged when raw is set
